## Idea

Describe the idea clearly.

## What part of Leviathan is this for?

Launcher, Client, Cast, website, app, cosmetics, accounts, shop, developer tools, server tools, integrations, or another public area.

## Why would this be useful?

Explain the player, developer, community, or platform problem it could improve.

## How could it work?

Describe the experience, flow, UI, behavior, or integration you have in mind.

## Examples or inspiration

Add public links, screenshots, mockups, or examples if useful. Do not include credentials, tokens, private endpoints, personal data, or other sensitive information.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps explain the idea.
